description: Call an arbitrary Blockscout API v2 endpoint path directly.

chain_id.description: Chain ID as a string, such as "1" for Ethereum.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

endpoint_path.description: Blockscout API v2 endpoint path to call.

json_body.description: JSON request body to send, as an object.

method.description: HTTP method to use, defaulting to GET.

query_params.description: Query parameters to send with the request, as an object.

name: direct_api_call
